steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Transformations: Moving or reflecting a graph without changing its basic shape.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: y = f(x) is transformed to y = f(x) + 5. Describe the transformation. | y = f(x) is transformed to y = f(x - 2). Describe the transformation. | y = f(x) is transformed to y = -f(x). Describe the transformation.
